trap.label: subjuntivo / account
trap.wrong: It is essential that the schedule is published.
trap.right: It is essential that the schedule be published.
trap.why: Falta a forma base do subjuntivo. Após essential/vital that, use be + particípio.

mcq.q: It is essential that the schedule ___ published.
Mixed A: If I ___ studied, I would be a doctor.

fix.wrong: It is vital that fees are paid.
fix.right: It is vital that fees be paid.

fix.wrong: If I would study, I would be a doctor.
fix.right: If I had studied, I would be a doctor.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “It is vital that fees are paid.”
rewrite.answer: It is vital that fees be paid.

rewrite.prompt: Misto A: “I didn’t study, so I am not a doctor.”
rewrite.answer: If I had studied, I would be a doctor.
